headline: 5 Michigan deals, $155.1M raised — led by LuxWall, Inc.

top_deals.summary: LuxWall, Inc., a Ypsilanti-based manufacturing company, filed a $111M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $77M sold to 11 investors.
Marnell Management Fund, L.P., a Farmington Hills-based hedge fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $78.1M sold to 50 investors. (Amended filing.)

new_funds.summary: Marnell Management Fund, L.P., a Farmington Hills-based hedge fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $78.1M sold to 50 investors. (Amended filing.)

material_agreements.summary: Hagerty, Inc. (HGTY) entered into a material definitive agreement.
Mercantile Bank Corp (MBWM) entered into a material definitive agreement (credit facility).
Presurance Holdings, Inc. (PRHI) entered into a material definitive agreement (equity financing).

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $155.1M sold across 2 Form D filings this week, down 29% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was LuxWall, Inc. (Ypsilanti, Manufacturing) targeting $111M. Good question to ask: are founders in manufacturing & automotive favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

1 Michigan-based pooled fund filed Form Ds, reporting $78.1M raised so far — led by Marnell Management Fund, L.P. (Hedge Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
Financial Services was the most active sector with 3 of 5 filings (60%). Ask contacts what's driving the activity, and whether it's showing up in their pipeline.
